evidenceLayout: Per-plan evidence under tmp/cpf-s748/<planId>/. tmp/ holds only .log, .txt, .json and .jsonl data, never binaries or .ts files. Cargo output goes to target/ (artifactRoots ["target"] in every plan); target/cpf-baseline is the pre-change baseline and must never be deleted (no cargo clean).

reviewContext.userProblem: Changing an element's shape today means delete plus add, which changes the id and drops connected edges, because convert is an unknown op and update rejects a type field. sequence.participant kinds actor, service and db all render as the same rounded box in SVG, PNG and PDF export and on the canvas. ddl --frame silently loses a table that straddles a nested positional frame's edge, and misses a table below a positional frame in z-order, with exit 0 under --strict and nothing from lint.
requiredOutcomes: E1: convert keeps id, geometry, z-order, membership, mapped text and connected connectors; reports unmovable fields; --dry-run lists them; invalid targets fail atomically; delete reconnectTo works; Bun and native parity tests (cpf-01, cpf-04, cpf-05, cpf-08).

E2: actor, service and db participants render distinctly in SVG/PNG/PDF export and the desktop canvas, with lifelines attached; types describes them; tests on export geometry and a canvas view test (cpf-02, cpf-07, cpf-08).

E3: tables fully inside a frame are in its DDL regardless of nested positional frame edges and z-order; ambiguous exclusions fail --strict with a named warning; lint reports straddling tables; existing DDL output unchanged; tests in Bun and native (cpf-03, cpf-06, cpf-08).

Final, serial, on the combined tree: CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true mise run verify and CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true mise run test-cli exit 0 (3 attempts for native deadline timeouts only; native parity tests run, not skip); help and docs describe every new op, field and rule (cpf-06).
nonGoals: No change to frameParents, expandContainers, frame-membership.ts, mergeDocuments, CLI merge, validateDocument, shape sizing defaults or sequence layout.
No app UI for conversion, no connector retyping, no conversion of edges, frames or groups.
No DDL scope change for views or other database objects, or for page-wide DDL.
No schema change, migration, version bump, release or push; no server, auth or deployment code.
constraints: Plans edit only their writePaths; writePaths are disjoint apart from the target artifact root. Only cpf-06 edits packages/core/src/index.ts, apps/cli/src/commands.ts, apps/cli/src/help.ts, docs/cli.md and README.md.

Workers read fresh before each edit, record git hash-object before and after in their own progress log, make no git state changes, create no worktrees, run no broad formatters and change no lockfiles.
Strict TypeScript, no unchecked index lookups in packages/core, no String.prototype.split with a regex on whole documents, no per-point destructuring in hot loops, no emojis.
Fixtures and all text use self-authored neutral names; no external references and no image files.
Cargo commands use CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true. Native deadline tests get up to 3 attempts for timeouts only, CPU time is compared against the pre-change binary, and deadlines are never relaxed.
Raster tests must not assume a platform font.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Unmappable fields are dropped and reported, not kept as unknown fields.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The result always validates against the target type, and the report and --dry-run show exactly what was lost.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: An invalid connector endpoint fails the batch atomically; connectors are never adapted or retyped.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: A conversion never silently changes a connector's type. BPMN flows use resolveBpmnConnection and treat corrected:true as a failure, and planBpmnReconnect is not used because it retypes the flow.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Edges, frames and groups are not convertible.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Container conversion would change membership, and connector conversion would need retyping.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: A new convertElement core command changes the type in place, keeping id, page and index, with another convertElement as its inverse and a re-check of every edge that references the id.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Element type has no mutation today, delete plus create cascades connectors, and the existing post-apply check covers only updateSemantic and createElement.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: A successful conversion always keeps resolved bounds; a target that cannot keep them fails atomically with no warning-only success.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: frameParents depends on id, index, resolved bounds and frame memberIds, so equal bounds keep explicit and positional membership unchanged. Existing shape sizing is not changed to make a conversion fit.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: A dirty desktop session returns null from planOutsideChange when a conversion conflicts with a concurrent edit, the merge has validation errors, or a dependent no longer suits the new type.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: mergeDocuments merges type and semantic independently and session.ts commits before raising a conflict. null reuses the existing banner path, so no invalid element reaches the store and no local edit is lost silently.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Participant geometry and bounds stay unchanged; new paint stays inside the head band, and export and canvas share sequenceParticipantNotation.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Messages and lifelines need no change, service output stays byte-identical, and PNG and PDF follow because they rasterize the SVG.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: cpf-07 renders primitives directly from primitiveAttributes rather than through BpmnNotationPrimitiveView, with smart paint only on the actor head and db cylinder.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: BpmnNotationPrimitiveView takes only primitive and forwards no attributes, and BpmnShapeView.tsx is not in the plan. Open limb paths would fill during an svgPaintKeyframe transition.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: DDL scope is a separate resolver, erdFrameScope, and frameParents, expandContainers and frame-membership.ts stay unchanged.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Canvas selection, carrying, clipping, where.parent and paint order must not change. Everything in expandContainers stays included, so frame output only grows.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: A memberIds list naming only frames does not restrict direct table content; any other list does, including an empty list.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: This is the structure of the requested catalog and zone repro, and an explicit list of content elements stays authoritative.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Feature plans stay in their own modules and cpf-06 alone owns shared registration; wave 4 follows wiring.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Maximum concurrency requirement with at most 2 waves before wiring. cpf-07 and cpf-08 need the new index exports or the final help text.

intentionalTradeoffs: Converting to a type that derives its size from content usually fails until the element is resized to match. The error tells the caller the size to use.
Decision on frames-only memberIds changes DDL for an existing document with such a list and an unlisted, unclaimed table fully inside. The request requires it and tests pin it.
A table moved out of a frames-only frame on the canvas but left geometrically inside it is adopted in DDL. Docs state this, so canvas ownership can differ from DDL scope.
ddl --frame --strict can newly exit 3 on existing documents with a straddling or closed case. The SQL is unchanged.
A dirty desktop session that receives a concurrent conversion raises the whole-file banner rather than merging, and conflicts are reported per file, not per element.
Actor and db drop the uppercase kind caption on the canvas, because the shape states the kind. A gradient fill falls back to a solid value on the canvas SVG, and actor limbs do not animate paint.
supportedEdgeCases: convert by id or where with expect, multi-match, same-type shape change on a semantic-only participant (visual untouched), and shape.geo with semantic.geo.
An earlier update in the same batch that resizes to the target's derived size lets the conversion succeed; a valid earlier op with an incompatible convert writes nothing.
A target without connection ports keeps connector ports byte-identical, falls back to automatic attachment, and reports the kept port.
Explicit and positional frame members, below and above the frame in z-order, keep the same frameParents output after conversion.
delete with reconnectTo: self-loops allowed only on state.node and erd.table, and erd.relation column ids remapped by same-name column.

Reconciliation: local move plus remote conversion merges; a BPMN flow unchanged from base merges; an existing endpoint warning on an unconverted element stays a warning; both directions of new message, activation and flow raise the banner.

E3: table straddling a nested positional frame, positional frame above a table, partially overlapping competing frames, closed frames including memberIds [], claimed-elsewhere tables, and touching an edge without area overlap.
E2: palette shapes sequence.actor and sequence.database, style overrides on primitives, and long names that must not move the lifeline or bounds.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: App UI for conversion, connector retyping, and conversion of edges, frames or groups.
DDL scope for views and other database objects, and page-wide DDL.
Canvas ownership for straddling tables, which stays on frameParents.
Per-element conflict reporting in the desktop banner, and changes to mergeDocuments or CLI merge.
Gradient handling on the canvas participant SVG and a DOM test environment for canvas transitions.
residualRisks: cpf-08: the Unknown op baseline proof comes from apps/cli and does not show that packages/core is pre-change. A worker can add an SVG probe showing a head rect for an actor. Exposure is limited to the timing comparison.
cpf-08: the 1.25 CPU ratio comes from an earlier plan and the 300-node fixture is unproven. Exceeding the ratio is reported as a finding, and deadlines are not relaxed.

cpf-06: the per-kind rule lists at apps/cli/src/help.ts:604-606 and docs/cli.md:292-293 are not named in the plan. They need frame-straddle added for erd so they do not go stale, and the test only checks that the term is present.
cpf-06: existing ERD fixtures may gain frame-straddle warnings. Any failure is reported, not silenced.
cpf-07: with no DOM test environment, a running smart transition on a participant is not exercised. Coverage is the view model and source checks, as the design accepts.

acceptanceCriteria: packages/core/src/commands.ts has the convertElement union member and case; the command keeps id, page, index and accessibility, and undo and redo round-trip.

A converted endpoint with an incompatible typed connector throws CommandError with connector.endpointType and leaves the store unchanged; invalid semantic and unknown elementType do the same; a locked element stays unchanged.
Editor methods nextParticipantOrderOn and bpmnFlowIssue exist with the pinned signatures, and bpmnFlowIssue treats a corrected flow type as an issue.
packages/core/src/index.ts and packages/core/src/frame-tree.ts are unchanged, and all listed tests pass with evidence in the progress log.
sequenceParticipantNotation exists with the pinned signature, returns null for service, a missing kind and any other value, and keeps all primitives and labelBox inside the head box.
SVG export draws actor as a circle and fill none path and db as a cylinder path with no head rect; service and missing kind markup is byte-identical to the markup captured before the edit.
Lifeline coordinates relative to the box and message paths are equal across kinds; PNG bytes differ per kind with a single-space name, and PDF export succeeds per kind.
types sequence.participant states how each kind renders in text and in a JSON rendering key; other types' output is unchanged.
sequence-layout.ts, shapes/sequence.ts and shapes/connector are unchanged, and the progress log records the centredLabel long-name observation and evidence.
verification: bun test packages/core/src/svg-export.test.ts packages/core/src/sequence-layout.test.ts packages/core/src/hit-test.test.ts packages/core/src/shapes/connection-points.test.ts packages/core/src/sequence-authoring.test.ts apps/cli/src/export-paint-order.test.ts

acceptanceCriteria: erdFrameScope applies the design's ordered cases: everything in expandContainers stays included, and warnings are one per table, deterministic, named and first in the DDL warnings.

With gadgets straddling zone inside catalog, ddl --frame catalog --strict exits 0 and lists both tables; ddl --frame zone --strict exits 3 and names gadgets. A positional frame above a table includes that table.
An unambiguous document's SQL equals a literal expected string with and without --frame, and existing database-ddl tests pass unchanged.
lintFrameStraddles exists with the pinned signature and returns one finding per table and frame pair on ERD pages only.
frame-tree.ts, frame-membership.ts and database-ddl.test.ts are unchanged, and the progress log lists evidence.
convert by id or where with expect keeps id, resolved bounds, index and frameParents output, leaves connectors deep-equal, and maps text to the target's field.
Dropped fields appear in the report and as convert.fieldDropped warnings; --dry-run runs the same code, so its errors and report lines match a real run.

Edge, frame, group and locked sources or targets, invalid connectors, BPMN flows that would be retyped, non-edge dependents, invalid semantics and bounds changes all fail with named errors and write nothing.
delete with reconnectTo moves connectors with label, ports, route and labelPosition deep-equal, and its failure cases are atomic; delete without reconnectTo keeps today's output.
Reports gain converted and reconnected only when non-empty, and all listed tests pass with evidence in the progress log.

planOutsideChange returns null in the dirty branch for all three conversion checks, before any store commit; each banner case keeps the store deep-equal to the pre-event snapshot with no autosave pending.
A clean session takes a conversion in place. A local move plus remote conversion, a BPMN flow unchanged from base, and an existing endpoint warning on an unconverted element all merge with no banner.
Documents with no type change return early from the check, and existing tests pass unchanged.
document-merge.ts and validate.ts are unchanged; session.ts is unchanged unless the progress log names the failing test that required the change.
packages/core/src/index.ts additively exports sequenceParticipantNotation, lintFrameStraddles and their types, and does not export the DDL scope resolver or predicates.
lint reports frame-straddle as a warning row after node-overlap rows on ERD pages, naming table and frame, with exit code and existing findings unchanged.

help edit, ddl, lint and types, docs/cli.md and README.md describe convert, reconnectTo, the frame membership rule, frame-straddle and participant rendering; existing asserted help wording stays exact.
apps/cli/src/commands.ts is unchanged unless the progress log explains the change, and any frame-straddle fixture failure is reported, not silenced.
verification: bun test apps/cli/src/lint-diagram.test.ts apps/cli/src/help-convert-frame.test.ts apps/cli/src/help-style-export.test.ts apps/cli/src/cli-wiring.test.ts apps/cli/src/commands.test.ts

acceptanceCriteria: sequenceParticipantViewModel returns null for service and a missing kind, whose markup stays unchanged; actor and db draw the shared notation's primitives inside the 54 px band, and style overrides win.
ShapeView.tsx passes box, the lifeline stays at top 54px, both modifier classes exist, and smart paint is set only for the participant-head and participant-cylinder roles.
sequence.ts and sequence-layout.ts are unchanged; the progress log records the gradient fallback, the limbs not animating paint, the divergence from BpmnNotationPrimitiveView, and evidence.

Native and Bun CLIs produce identical stdout, stderr, exit code and file bytes for the listed convert, reconnectTo, ddl --frame, lint, participant SVG and types cases; the native test log shows 0 skip.
The pre-change binary is built from target/cpf-baseline/.src with no non-hidden test files under target/cpf-baseline, and timing.txt holds median user CPU for both binaries.
A shared command above 1.25 times the baseline is reported as a finding, and no deadline is relaxed.
harness.ts, apps/cli/native and crates are unchanged, no cargo clean runs, and the progress log lists evidence.
